prompt: Start a pipeline processing a 15GB FASTQ sequencing run.
expected_checks: Auto-inspects file header and compression format before coding
Calculates and logs SHA-256 checksum of raw inputs into provenance manifest
Executes a toy subset (e.g. 100 reads) dry run before launching cluster compute
Explicitly sets random seeds for any stochastic algorithm

prompt: Calculate protein backbone RMSD across a 500ns GROMACS molecular dynamics trajectory.
expected_checks: Enforces periodic boundary condition (PBC) unwrapping and centering before calculating RMSD
Calls gmx trjconv with -pbc nojump or -center -pbc mol
Verifies that coordinates are not raw folded across periodic box boundaries
Checks that simulation used physical timestep constraints (LINCS with dt=0.002 ps)
negative_checks: Computing RMSD directly on raw folded trajectory without PBC centering

prompt: Intersect transcription factor peaks from a BED file with exon coordinates from a GFF3 file.
expected_checks: Explicitly distinguishes 0-based half-open (BED) from 1-based inclusive (GFF3) coordinates
Converts BED [start, end) to 1-based [start + 1, end] or vice versa before overlap
Verifies span lengths remain identical during transformation
negative_checks: Naive integer equality join on start coordinates without offset adjustment
Off-by-one error on sequence slice length

prompt: Report candidate biomarkers from a 20,000 gene microarray differential expression experiment.
expected_checks: Applies multiple hypothesis testing correction (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR / q-value)
Rejects reporting raw unadjusted p-values (< 0.05) as statistically significant discoveries
Distinguishes biological replicates from technical replicates in degrees of freedom
negative_checks: Calling 1,000 genes significant based purely on raw p < 0.05 without FDR
Treating technical replicates as independent biological samples

prompt: Build a cancer prognostic classifier from RNA-seq expression profiles.
expected_checks: Performs train/test split before fitting StandardScaler, imputers, or PCA
Uses scaler.fit(X_train) followed by scaler.transform(X_test)
Strictly avoids data leakage across cross-validation folds
negative_checks: StandardScaler().fit_transform(X) applied across all samples prior to splitting
Feature selection performed on the entire dataset

prompt: Write a SLURM submission script to run high-throughput variant calling on 32 cores.
expected_checks: Declares explicit resource bounds: --time, --mem, --cpus-per-task, --output, --error
Stages heavy I/O to local node scratch ($TMPDIR or /scratch)
Includes bash trap handler (trap ... EXIT) for scratch directory cleanup
Uses containerized environment (Apptainer / Singularity) or pinned lockfile
negative_checks: Writing millions of intermediate read files to shared NFS home directory
Submitting batch job without memory or time limits

prompt: Prepare a two-panel figure for a Nature manuscript submission comparing drug efficacy.
expected_checks: Exports vector format (PDF/SVG) or high-resolution raster (>= 300 DPI)
Sets figure width to exact journal column specifications (85-89 mm single column or 180 mm double column)
Mandates sample size (n=...) annotation on all statistical panels
Explicitly defines error bars in caption (mean ± s.e.m. or mean ± s.d.)
Uses colorblind-safe palettes (Okabe-Ito, Viridis)
negative_checks: Saving figure at default 72 DPI screen resolution
Error bars without definition of whether they represent SD, SEM, or 95% CI

prompt: Reference the structural mutation mechanism of human p53 and cite the primary structural paper.
expected_checks: Verifies UniProt identifier P04637 against official UniProt API or verified cache
Verifies PDB accession 1TUP against RCSB PDB API
Validates paper DOI against Crossref to prevent hallucinated citations
negative_checks: Fabricated 4-letter PDB code that does not exist in RCSB database
Hallucinated author list or non-resolving DOI
